UAT-14OCT-STORY-017
Overview

Job requisition creation & approval

Prototype walkthrough — UAT-14OCT-STORY-017

A Hiring Manager requests a new job opening; a Recruiter or HR Admin must approve it before it is published and open to candidates. This prototype covers requisition creation, approval/rejection, publishing, and reassigning an open requisition's owner. It does not cover candidate sourcing or pipeline movement.

Status chip legend

Draft saved, not yet submitted Pending approval awaiting a Recruiter/HR Admin Open published, visible to candidates Rejected sent back to the hiring manager

Hiring Manager

Draft, submit, and track your own requisitions. Resubmit anything that was rejected.

Recruiter / HR Admin

Approve or reject pending requisitions, and reassign an open requisition's owner.

Candidate

Browse and apply to open roles only — unapproved requisitions never appear.
